title: Al-Mutaffifin 83:13-18 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-Mutaffifin and the sifat of weakness and emphasis
source: Written for quran/y6 lesson 22 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Mutaffifin 83:13-18 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 22. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ (١٣) كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ (١٤) كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ (١٥) ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ (١٦) ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ (١٧) كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ (١٨)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.
Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."
No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun.

Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Saktah: a tiny pause (small س) instead of idgham
Pause on the laam without a breath, then raan
Idgham without ghunnah: ن into ر

keywords.def: a covering stain on the heart
a short pause without a breath

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Mutaffifin 83:13-18 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 83:13-18 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: The small س over «بَلْ» in 83:14 tells us to ...
questions.a: make a short pause with no breath (saktah)
options: make a short pause with no breath (saktah)
merge the laam into the raa

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 83:13-18 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Find the qalqalah letters in 83:13 to 18 that have a sukoon.
questions.a: For example: يَكْسِبُونَ has no qalqalah; ٱلْأَبْرَارِ has ب with sukoon: qalqalah.

questions.q: Explain the saktah in 83:14 and why it helps the meaning.
questions.a: A tiny pause on بَلْ without breath stops the laam merging into raa, so بَلْ and رَانَ stay two clear words.

questions.q: 83:15 says that Day the deniers will be ...
questions.a: A) partitioned (screened) from their Lord. 83:15: 'Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.'

questions.q: Think again: Allah says sins left a stain (raan) on the hearts of the deniers (83:14). How can a person keep the heart clean?
questions.a: By stopping the sin, saying astaghfirullah, doing good deeds and remembering Allah.
